# Pogoda.kg

> Pogoda.kg publishes weather forecasts for 17 cities in Kyrgyzstan: current
> conditions, an hourly forecast and a 7-day outlook for each city, plus a daily
> briefing and weather for five mountain passes. Forecast data comes from the
> Open-Meteo API and is refreshed in the browser every 15 minutes. The site is
> available in three languages: Kyrgyz (default, unprefixed URLs), Russian (/ru)
> and English (/en).

## Main Pages

- [Homepage (Kyrgyz)](https://pogoda.kg/): Live weather for Bishkek plus quick access to every city.
- [Homepage (English)](https://pogoda.kg/en/): English-language homepage.
- [Homepage (Russian)](https://pogoda.kg/ru/): Russian-language homepage.
- [Daily Briefing](https://pogoda.kg/daily): Today's forecast for Bishkek, Osh, Karakol, Naryn and Jalal-Abad, updated every morning.
- [Mountain Passes](https://pogoda.kg/passes): Weather at Too-Ashuu, Ala-Bel, Dolon, Otmek and Tuz-Bel. Road access is confirmed only by the Ministry of Transport.
- [Interactive Weather Map](https://pogoda.kg/map): Live temperature markers for all 17 cities on a map of Kyrgyzstan.
- [Weather News](https://pogoda.kg/blog): Kyrgyzstan weather articles, mountain pass conditions and seasonal guides.
- [FAQ](https://pogoda.kg/faq): Climate questions and answers for Kyrgyzstan and each city.
- [Contact](https://pogoda.kg/contact): Weather data inquiries, partnerships and feedback.
- [Privacy Policy](https://pogoda.kg/privacy)
- [Terms of Service](https://pogoda.kg/terms)

## City Forecast Pages

Each of the 17 cities below has its own forecast page (current conditions,
hourly forecast and 7-day outlook), at the root path in Kyrgyz and under /ru/
and /en/ for Russian and English:

Bishkek (capital), Osh, Jalal-Abad, Karakol, Tokmok, Uzgen, Kara-Balta,
Balykchy, Naryn, Talas, Batken, Cholpon-Ata, Kant, Kemin, Kyzyl-Kiya,
Toktogul, Razzakov.

Example: https://pogoda.kg/bishkek (Kyrgyz), https://pogoda.kg/ru/bishkek
(Russian), https://pogoda.kg/en/bishkek (English).

## Notes for AI Agents

- Weather values (temperature, wind, precipitation) are live data fetched
  client-side from the Open-Meteo API and change continuously; treat any
  specific number as a snapshot.
- Articles are published in Kyrgyz (/blog/<slug>), Russian (/ru/blog/<slug>)
  and English (/en/blog/<slug>).
- The sitemap at https://pogoda.kg/sitemap.xml lists every indexable URL.
